summary: Zhihu Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing Next Day Disclosure Returns under Hong Kong Listing Rules, reporting ongoing share buybacks for cancellation. Between July 1 and July 28, 2026, the company repurchased over 2.2 million WVR ordinary shares at prices ranging from USD 1.0416 to USD 1.0944 per share, representing roughly 0.9% of issued shares. These repurchases are part of an ongoing capital return program aimed at reducing share count and returning cash to shareholders. The filing reflects routine disclosures of executed buybacks, not a new tender offer or strategic transaction. Watch for continued repurchase activity and potential impact on shareholder value and liquidity.
